value: high: brackets turn on Game Changer count and the flag is free in Scryfall data
spec: Add game_changer INTEGER to cards; read it in server/src/cards/import.rs. Card sheet (Cards.tsx CardSheet) shows a Game Changer tag. Deck page shows 'Game Changers: N' with names. Add is:gamechanger to server search and packages/core/src/search.ts, and include the flag in the offline bundle.

value: high: small, large, border_crop and art_crop JPEGs disappear on 2027-01-01 and Yama reads small, normal and art_crop
spec: In import.rs read image_uris.thumb, grid, display and art, falling back to small, normal, jpeg and art_crop. Re-run import-cards. Resolve URLs from JSON, never from format=image redirects. Keep column names; only the URLs change.

feature: Commander art behind each life panel
value: high: Bryan asked for Mythic Tools-style art backgrounds
spec: PlayerSetup.art is already filled from image_art_crop. In TablePlay Panel, draw it as a cover background under a dark scrim; keep the mana bands as a thin strip. Player sheet shows 'Art by <artist>' (Scryfall rule for art crops). Per-device toggle to fall back to colors. Use CSS tokens, not felt green.

value: high: settles disputes at the table and in online play
spec: During import, load Scryfall's rulings bulk file (5.2 MB gz JSONL) into rulings(oracle_id, source, published_at, comment). GET /api/cards/:id returns them. CardSheet shows a collapsible 'Rulings (n)' list with date and source; the online board Inspector reuses it.

feature: Bracket, Game Changers and combos per deck version
value: high: one free call gives bracket evidence for rule 0 and planning
spec: On each deck version save (server/src/decks.rs), POST commanders and main to Commander Spellbook /estimate-bracket with User-Agent Yama/<version>, staying well under 80 req/min. Store deck_version_checks(version_id, checked_at, bracket_tag, game_changers, mld, extra_turns, combos json). Deck page panel: estimated bracket (R=4, S/P=3, O/C=2, E=1), card flags and two-card combos with speed, labelled 'estimate, checked DATE', with credit and a link. Offline fallback: local GC count floor.

value: high: the group talks in brackets; declared and estimated must stay separate
spec: Add bracket (1-5, nullable) to decks; edit it in EditDeck. Chip on DecksPage rows, table seat setup and the online lobby. Show declared next to estimated; never overwrite one with the other.

value: high: curve and color sources are the first thing people check after a swap
spec: Compute on the client from DeckView: mana curve split creatures and noncreatures, average MV with and without lands, land count, and colored pips needed vs land sources per color (flag colors under 1 source per 3 pips). Show under the figures on DeckPage.

value: high: Bryan pastes lists into EDHbots and Moxfield
spec: Deck page export menu: plain list with Commander and Deck headers, names only (EDHbots), Moxfield format with (SET) number from the owned copy or default printing, MTGA. Copy to clipboard or download .txt. Reuse listText in Decks.tsx.

feature: First player and win rate by seat
value: high: seat 1 wins about 29% vs 21.5% for seat 4 in playgroup.gg data; Yama doesn't record who went first
spec: Add a set_first table event in packages/core/src/table.ts; 'Roll for first' dispatches it and the table menu offers 'X goes first'. Store games.first_seat (migration), also in LogGame. Stats: win rate by position relative to the first player, with playgroup.gg's 29.2/25.7/23.6/21.5% shown as a reference until 20 games.

value: high: win condition and fun make stats worth reading
spec: The finish flow and LogGame add optional chips for win condition (combat, commander damage, combo, alternate win, mill, poison, concession, other) and an optional fun rating 1-5 per player. Store in games (result json or new columns). Group page shows a win-condition breakdown.

value: high: cheap, fun game-night talking points from data already stored
spec: In playgroups.rs stats, use game_seats.eliminated_by_seat and eliminated_turn for a head-to-head table (who knocked out whom), archnemesis per player, first out and last out counts, and current win streaks. New 'Highlights' section on the Group page.

value: high: shows whether upgrades help at this table
spec: Group finished games by game_seats.deck_version_id. Deck page shows 'This version: W-L, n games' plus earlier versions with their notes. Stats can roll up by deck across versions. Show n and fade under 5 games.

value: high: feeds commander-decks data/games.json for the lab's real-game loop (E5)
spec: GET /api/games/export.json and .csv per user or playgroup: seats, players, deck version ids and labels, first seat, winner, win condition, turns, eliminations, dates. The JSON matches commander-decks data/games.json. Button on the Group page.

value: high: a deck with unsupported cards plays wrong online
spec: Read phase coverage data from data/engine. In PlayHome, when a deck is picked for a seat, list unsupported or partial cards before start. Deck page shows 'Online play: 99/100 cards supported' with the names.

value: high: Star Trek Commander previews run 10-26 to 10-29 and Bryan pre-ordered all four decks
spec: Daily job reads Scryfall /sets with released_at today or later: name, type, release date, card_count as a preview progress bar. 'Upcoming' card on the Cards page. Watch a set (trc); when its decklists exist (Scryfall cards or MTGJSON), show 'create stock deck'. An admin note field records delays such as Wizards' 2026-10-16 notice.

value: medium: small samples mislead a friend group
spec: Every rate shows n. Rows under 5 games are faded and labelled provisional. Add expected share for pod size (1/N) next to win rate. Stamp 'computed DATE'.

feature: Stock / now / after states and diff
value: high: the gap no mainstream builder fills (Moxfield #42, #48 open)
spec: deck_states(deck_id, label, version_id) with labels stock, now, after plus custom. Deck page tabs per state. Version history list (the server already lists versions) with notes and dates and 'make current'. Diff any two versions or decks: adds and cuts with images and counts.
inspired_by: Deckstats revisions, Archidekt snapshots, commander-decks compare lists

feature: Swaps with reason, source and status
value: high: core of the per-user planner
spec: swaps(id, owner_id, deck_id, add_oracle, cut_oracle, reason, source owned|buy|print|borrow, got json, order_ref, status proposed|want|planned|bought|printed|installed|rejected, group, created_at). 'After' = now plus planned swaps. Card sheet gets 'Propose for deck...'. Owner checks on every endpoint.

feature: Free copies, deck usage and spares
value: high: Bryan's rule is to check spares before buying or printing
spec: Per printing: free = owned minus copies in current deck versions minus lent minus promised. Collection rows show 'in Deck A, Deck B'. Spares page: cards cut from decks still owned (now and after prints), with location and source. Proposals show 'spare in X' before buy or print.

value: high: replaces the local review site for every user
spec: Page listing proposed swaps with add and cut images, Oracle text, reason, dated price and stock. Buttons want, maybe, no; pick another cut; note. Accept all per group; locked cards never offered as cuts. Answers keyed by swap id and never deleted; a 'no' on a planned swap asks what to do.

value: high: makes installing swaps a two-minute job
spec: For ticked swaps, list 'pull <card> from <binder>' and 'take out <card>, file in <spares box>'. Ticking each creates collection move ops and marks the swap installed; the now state advances.

value: high: one global buy list with local stores first
spec: Buy-sourced swaps carry a dated price and per-store stock checks (store, variant, price, checked_at). Buy list grouped by store with cart links: Shopify /cart/<variant>:<qty>, TCGplayer massentry?productline=Magic&c= (undocumented, test first), Card Kingdom builder paste. Never-above-market check against the latest snapshot. A 'bought it' tap records store and price for confirmation.
inspired_by: ScryPrice, Cardmarket Shopping Wizard, commander-decks buylist.py

value: high: Bryan prints what isn't worth buying at MPC
spec: Print-sourced swaps form a print list. Export MPC Autofill XML (stock from settings, default S33; slots; card names as queries) and a names list for Proxxied. Track orders: placed, expected, arrived. Arrival marks copies as proxies and makes swaps installable. Only the XML format is used; MPC Autofill code is GPL.
inspired_by: MPC Autofill, Proxxied, commander-decks print order

value: high: Bryan's existing plans arrive as his data
spec: Admin-only upload of data/planner/bundle.json (deck-lab-plan P1-P3) into Bryan's planner tables, stamped with the guide version. Inbox table for review answers, bought taps and installed ticks; GET endpoint for scripts/planner/pull.py. Upload never overwrites inbox answers.

value: high: lets one deck play at bracket 2, 3 or 4
spec: A bag is a named set of IN/OUT pairs on top of a core version, with a target bracket. Compile: 100 cards, singleton, color identity, GC count, Spellbook estimate, resulting bracket; show an IN/OUT checklist and a reset path. Missing metrics show 'not checked', never zero.

value: high: shows when a swap cuts ramp without replacing it
spec: Daily import of Scryfall oracle_tags bulk; walk child_ids; store card_roles(oracle_id, role, tag_id) for about 10 roles (ramp, draw, removal, sweeper, counterspell, tutor, protection, recursion, mana-rock, mana-dork). Deck page shows counts against targets (e.g. ramp 10-14) for each state; each swap shows '+1 removal, -1 ramp'. Admin hide list by tag id. Add otag: to search.
inspired_by: Scryfall Tagger, Archidekt, TableCommander Deck Shape, Farseek

value: high: every plan starts from a stock precon; Star Trek decks are coming
spec: Server caches MTGJSON's Commander deck lists (198 precons). 'Add a precon' picker creates a deck plus a stock state. Owned/needed works immediately. Refresh when MTGJSON adds decks.

value: medium-high: Bryan's shopping rules become settings friends can change
spec: Settings page: preferred stores in order, print service and stock, never above market, shiny only if no plain version, budget per tier, never-suggest list, table bracket. Read by the buy list, print list and proposal filters.

value: medium-high: shows what each tier costs and does
spec: For each swap group or tier: card count, cost from dated prices (missing shown as missing), cumulative or standalone stated, resulting bracket and GC count, and a combo warning.

feature: Combos one card away, matched to collection
value: medium-high: free upgrade ideas and early combo warnings
spec: Use find-my-combos almostIncluded for each state. Tag each missing card 'you own it' or 'spare in X'. Warn on the review screen when a proposal completes a two-card combo.

value: medium-high: new cards for watched decks without reading every spoiler
spec: When an import adds oracle ids, score each watched deck: inside color identity and sharing a role, type or keyword with the commander or deck themes. Show hits with a reason and price, and list decks checked with no hits. No LLM in v1.

value: medium: collect ideas while browsing
spec: 'Add to tray' on the card sheet and search results; tray drawer; 'send to deck' makes proposals with a cut picker and a reason field.

value: medium: a place for deferred ideas
spec: Board 'maybe' in deck_versions.cards, left out of size, legality, ownership cost and exports. Review 'maybe' answers can send cards here.

value: medium: shows the effect of land and ramp swaps
spec: Run 10k hands with packages/core goldfish.ts per state: chance of missing a land drop by turns 2, 3 and 4, flood, and a sweet-spot rate. Show it on DeckPage next to sample hands.

value: medium: proxies and printings matter for owned/needed
spec: Toggles on the deck page: match exact printing or any printing; count proxies as owned or not. 'Un-proxy' list of proxies that now have a real copy free.

value: medium-high: makes the pregame talk quick
spec: Playgroup gets a house-rules text field. Table setup shows each seat's declared and estimated bracket, GC count and combos. A per-deck Rule 0 card can be shown by QR.

feature: Type a life total, plus or minus 10
value: medium: faster big swings
spec: Tapping the life total opens a numeric keypad that logs one life event. Player sheet adds -10/+10 steppers.

feature: Dice, coin, random player and seats
value: medium: everything for game start in one place
spec: Table menu dice tray (d4-d20, custom, several dice), coin flip, random opponent. 'Shuffle seats' in NewGame. A roll result can set the first player through set_first.

value: medium: common mechanics the counter lacks
spec: Extend CounterKind in packages/core/src/table.ts with storm, treasure, mana, city's blessing, ring (level), speed and named custom counters. Show only counters in use as badges.

value: medium: rotated panels misread 6 and 9
spec: Underline 6 and 9 on rotated panels. OLED black option. Bigger digits setting. Stored per device.

value: medium: faster logging of paper games
spec: 'Rematch' prefills the last game's seats and decks. Optional placements and how each player went out. Same win-condition chips as the finish flow.

value: medium: an outside reference for stock precons
spec: Admin form stores precon, stock win rate, games, date and URL. Decks with a stock state matching the precon show it, labelled as outside data.

value: medium: some nights run long
spec: Modes: per-turn stopwatch, per-player time bank, chess clock. Pause and resume, optional reminder at N minutes. Ticks stay out of the event log; pass_turn timestamps give turn lengths for stats.
inspired_by: Lifetap chess clock, Mythic Tools Blitz

value: medium: fun to look back on a game
spec: From game_events: life line per player by turn, knockouts, commander damage totals. Recap page per game, visible to the playgroup and linked from recent games.

value: medium: a big screen at game night
spec: Read-only route /table/watch/:code on the existing table room: big totals, turn, active seat, monarch and initiative. The code persists for the evening so the TV follows the next game.

feature: Elo per player and deck version
value: medium: a fairer ranking than raw win rate
spec: Replay finished games in date order. The winner beats each loser pairwise with K/(N-1), K=24, base 1200. Rate players and deck versions separately. Show the formula and a low-sample flag.
inspired_by: TurnZero MMR, Nerd Leagues, Cube Cobra code

value: medium: nights with more than one pod
spec: Check in who's present, split into pods of 3-5 (avoid repeats from last time, optional Elo balance), random seats and first player, one shared table room per pod, night standings, TV view.

value: medium: tests the lab against reality
spec: Before a game or night, record predicted shares per seat (by hand or from the lab). After the game, score with Brier and show a running record.

value: medium-low: a hidden-role night that fits the QR table
spec: Host deals roles for 4-8 players through the table room. Each phone sees only its own role; the Leader is face up; unveil from the table. Card text from treachery.app/cards.json with credit, no art. Roles recorded with the game.

value: low-medium: a common Commander variant
spec: Host holds a planar deck built from plane and phenomenon cards already in the Scryfall import. Active plane shown on every phone; planar die with extra-roll cost; planeswalk. Works with Commander rules.

value: low: occasional need
spec: Commander damage stepper gets options: lifelink (attacker gains the same life) and infect (poison instead of life).

value: high: filing many cards row by row is slow
spec: Multi-select rows (checkbox or long press). Actions: move to container, set condition, finish, language, proxy, delete. Sent as one batch of collection ops.

feature: Who in the playgroup owns X
value: medium-high: borrow before you buy
spec: Container visibility: private, playgroup counts, playgroup full, link token. Card sheet and buy list show 'In your playgroup: Alex x1 (spare)'. Never share purchase prices or notes.
inspired_by: Mythic Tools shared collections, Deckbox privacy

value: medium-high: Bryan buys locally first
spec: Port commander-decks local-store search: Shopify search/suggest.json and variant .js availability for listed stores; YesTCG list search for others (personal use, 4 or fewer requests at once). Results saved as dated stock checks on proposals.

value: medium: move one copy without workarounds
spec: The move dialog asks how many copies; the server splits the row.

value: medium: friends coming from ManaBox or Moxfield
spec: Presets for ManaBox, Moxfield, Archidekt, Dragon Shield, Deckbox and TCGplayer. Match by Scryfall ID, then set and number, else flag 'unsure'. Downloadable errors CSV. Check MtgCsvHelper's license before reusing its mapping.

value: medium: faster sorting
spec: Scanner shows 'own N, in Deck X', a session total, an optional sound above a price threshold, and a set lock.

value: medium: stores send other printings than listed
spec: Compare a scan session or import with recorded purchases by set and collector number. Lists: to check, missing, fine. No changes until confirmed.

value: medium: friends' spares fill decks
spec: One tap turns a state's needed cards into a want list. Match against playgroup spares and trade lists, strict (same printing) or relaxed. Matches show on the deck page and buy list.

value: medium: lending is common and nobody tracks it well
spec: loans(lender, borrower, scryfall_id, finish, qty, deck_version_id, lent_at, due_at, returned_at, note). Borrowed is a third state in owned/needed. Return tasks when a borrowed card is cut. A lent deck's games credit the deck and the pilot separately.
inspired_by: Gap in Deckbox and Mythic Tools

value: medium: compare beyond TCGplayer market
spec: Daily AllPricesToday: Card Kingdom, Mana Pool and Cardsphere retail with source and date in price_snapshots. Buylist prices kept separate and filtered to qty_buying > 0, never shown as retail.

value: medium: Bryan and his wife share cards
spec: Share a collection with another user; both can edit; owner shown per copy; decks count both owners' copies.

value: low-medium: occasional trades at the table
spec: Two sides of lines with dated prices and source. Override a line with a reason. A missing price marks the total incomplete. Both phones join by QR; apply moves copies atomically.

value: low-medium: buy when a card dips
spec: Watch a card at a threshold; check after each daily import; in-app notice with the dated price.

value: low-medium: keeps imported IDs valid
spec: After import, apply Scryfall /migrations to collection_items and deck_versions.

value: low: nice to see
spec: Chart collection market value by date from stored snapshots, with a note for cards that had no price.

value: medium: players miss their turn in another tab
spec: When the view says a decision is waiting, play a short chime and change the tab title; setting to turn it off.

value: medium: knocked-out players and friends can watch
spec: Route /play/:id/watch using the server's spectator view and Board's existing spectator state; no hidden information.

value: medium: review AI and friend games
spec: From the saved replay log: step by turn or action, 1-10x speed, clickable game log, life chart, all hands revealed after the game. Pinned to the recording engine version.

value: medium: fixes misclicks
spec: Expose phase's takeback request, response and cancel; actions pause during the vote.

value: medium: a draft night with friends and AI
spec: Lobby on phase draft-core: CommanderDraft (4-pod, pick two), Winston for 2, cube from a Cube Cobra ID. Finished pools go to the existing match runner.

value: low-medium: tougher practice
spec: Add the presets from phase-ai config to the skill menu in PlayHome.

value: low-medium: opt-in experiment
spec: phase-llm Anthropic provider; the model picks a legal option index and the engine checks it again. Estimate before the game and log tokens and cost per game.

value: low: comfort
spec: Per-phase stop settings; a copyable invite link next to the code.

value: low: slow players online
spec: Optional time bank per seat; auto-pass when it runs out.

value: low: variety nights
spec: Lobby format choice using phase FormatConfig; shared planar or scheme decks; curate a list of planes that work in the engine.

value: low: drafted decks drop straight into a table
spec: Accept /play/import?dt=<MTGA text>&d=<deflated base64>&t=<ticket>&n=<name>; the same ticket pairs players.

value: high: measured stock vs now vs after
spec: Batch job: deck files in, seats rotated, seeded games, JSON lines out. Stamp engine version, card-data hash, AI level per seat, seed, field id with list hashes, deck-version hash, game count and date.

value: high: shows the lab inside Yama
spec: Win share with 95% intervals by pod size; stock to now to after; every number shows engine, games and date.

value: high: tells which upgrades matter
spec: From a proposal: run both arms on the same seeds; report the change with an interval; inside the interval means no difference; confirm on a fresh seed before suggesting.

value: medium: speed is half of a bracket
spec: Turn to win on an empty table per state, from phase all-AI solo runs.

value: medium: how far to trust the engine
spec: Simulate ranked precons; rank-correlate with playgroup.gg's stock rates; show the result and date.

value: medium: the opponent matters most
spec: Results split by opponent deck; unsupported cards per deck version listed beside results.

value: medium: which cards pull weight
spec: From online and sim replay logs: win rate when drawn, when cast, and in the opening hand, against not drawn; per deck version; low-sample flags.

value: low-medium: two engines agreeing is stronger evidence
spec: Run Forge sim -f commander as a separate process on saget; parse results into the same JSON lines. Never copy GPL code.

value: medium: bad wifi at game night
spec: Add rulings for cards in the user's decks to the offline bundle.

value: medium: bans and GC changes affect brackets
spec: Home card with the next B&R date (2026-11-30) and the last GC change. When game_changer flips in an import, list affected decks.

value: medium: readable reasons and notes
spec: Render [[name]] as a tappable card chip in notes, swap reasons and comments; ! for the image, ? for rulings.

value: medium: share a list outside Yama
spec: Unlisted token per deck version, read-only, regenerate to revoke, not indexed.

value: medium: trust and backups
spec: One zip with collection CSV, decks with versions, plans and games JSON.

value: medium: power searches
spec: Add otag:, produces:, r:, s:, cn:, a:, year, new:, is:reprint, !exact and regex to search.ts and the server, offline where data allows.

value: medium: friends help with upgrades
spec: Comments and reactions on decks and swaps, visible to the playgroup. 'Ask the playgroup' opens a request; friends propose swaps into the owner's review queue.

value: medium: rules text changes quietly
spec: On each import, diff name, cost, type, Oracle text, P/T, Commander legality and game_changer into oracle_history; 'changed cards in your decks' list.

value: medium: the design pick is pending
spec: Apply the chosen design tokens across styles.css; no felt green.

value: low-medium: quick rule lookups
spec: Rule numbers in rulings link to Yawgatog anchors now; later parse the dated CR TXT on the server for search and link to Wizards.

value: low-medium: better for everyone
spec: Screen reader labels review, larger text setting, optional dyslexia-friendly font.

value: low-medium: Bryan's agents can read his data
spec: Read-only MCP tools for decks, plans, collection and games, per user token.

value: low-medium: optional help
spec: Claude picks from a pre-filtered candidate list (identity, legality, owned or budget). Output goes to the review queue, never into a deck. Store model, prompt version and date.

value: low: rules practice
spec: Fetch RulesGuru questions for the deck's cards server-side, cached, shown with credit and a link.

value: low: only if the group uses Discord
spec: Per-playgroup webhook URL; post results and new deck versions.

value: low: organization
spec: Markdown notes per deck version; folder UI on the existing decks.folder column.

value: low: more structure than the group needs
spec: Seasons with custom points for kills, saves and first blood, minus points for infinites and long turns.

value: low: the PWA covers Android
spec: Capacitor Android build only if the PWA hits a camera or storage limit.

value: low: build only if asked
spec: Set completion; tags and trade quantity on copies; copy photos; packages; basics helper; token list; cost by category; natural-language search; printed text toggle; other languages; OBS overlay; in-game notes; drag to attack; Archenemy and Bounty at the table; mulligan tracking; result confirmation; achievements; playgroup chat; share card; shipping optimizer; Direct signal; buylist value; home-print PDF; CR diff; LLM rules Q&A; webcam seats; notifications; phantom-opponent goldfish.
